title: OpenAI rolls out GPT‑5.5 Instant
summary: OpenAI made GPT‑5.5 Instant the new default ChatGPT model, delivering 52.5% fewer hallucinations and more natural, concise answers. Paid tiers retain GPT‑5.3 for three months. The release strengthens reliability for everyday use.

title: OpenAI launches realtime voice models
summary: OpenAI introduced GPT‑Realtime‑2, GPT‑Realtime‑Translate, and GPT‑Realtime‑Whisper APIs. These enable live reasoning, multilingual speech translation, and streaming transcription, expanding natural voice agent capabilities.

title: Microsoft announces Agent 365 GA
summary: Microsoft released Agent 365 for general availability, extending identity, security, and governance tooling to AI agents across enterprise environments. The platform strengthens compliance and enterprise adoption.

title: Microsoft AI revenue surges
summary: Microsoft reported AI revenue run rate surpassing $37B, with Azure growing 40% year‑over‑year. Analysts note strong demand for Copilot and enterprise AI services, pushing Microsoft’s market cap above $3T.

title: Anthropic signs $200B Google Cloud deal
summary: Anthropic committed $200B over five years to Google Cloud, representing over 40% of Google’s future contracted cloud revenue. The deal briefly pushed Alphabet’s market cap ahead of Nvidia in after‑hours trading.

title: Google I/O 2026: Gemini 4.0 and Android 17
summary: Google is expected to unveil Gemini 4.0, Android 17, and XR smart glasses at I/O 2026. Gemini upgrades will deepen integration across Search, Workspace, and Shopping, while Android 17 emphasizes AI‑native features.

title: AI chat logs deemed legally discoverable
summary: US courts ruled that AI chatbot logs (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) qualify as business records and can be subpoenaed in litigation. Enterprises face new compliance and privacy risks in handling conversational data.
